description: This file defines a JiraService class that provides methods to interact with JIRA's REST API, including retrieving issues, creating issues, and adding comments.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A lightweight JIRA REST client for essential JIRA operations.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: Optional[str] = None, email: Optional[str] = None, api_token: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes JiraService with optional base_url, email, and api_token; sets up an asynchronous HTTP client.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Closes the asynchronous HTTP client connection.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_issue(self, issue_id_or_key: str)
methods.description: Fetches a JIRA issue by its ID or key.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_issue(self, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task")
methods.description: Creates a new JIRA issue with specified project key, summary, description, and issue type.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_comment(self, issue_id_or_key: str, body: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to an existing JIRA issue.
